C1305.title: Jinhua Ge Mou Large-Scale Fake Investment Platform Fraud Case
C1305.summary: A fraud syndicate led by Ge Mou set up operations in Cambodia, using fake investment platforms such as Jintouhui, UBS Warburg, and Lisheng Securities to lure victims into groups under the guise of free lectures and stock recommendations, carrying out targeted multi-on-one precision scams.
